title: Track
body:
Syntax: perform track <mob or player name>

Track is a scroll-learned general technique (level 30) that automatically pursues a mob or online player through connected rooms inside the target's area. Advanced Tracking is a separate scroll-only upgrade available at level 20 that allows cross-area pursuit with the same command. Both stop at hidden exits until the automatic level-50 Hidden Tracking passive is unlocked. Hidden Tracking then permits tracking through hidden passages, including exits without doors. Closed doors still block every version. Moves one room per pulse, pauses in combat, and costs 5 Chakra per pulse.
